findings.F1: Inside the choppy profile, a coin's 30-day return scaled by its 30-day daily swing ranks its next 7-day unusual move with a Spearman of 0.276 (215 non-overlapping cases), against 0.028 outside the choppy profile (1004 cases). In choppy, the quintiles of the scaled 30-day return run from -8.9 % (lowest, 18 days) and -4.5 % (second, t -3.57, 35 days) through -0.4 % to +2.5 % and +1.6 % (top two).
findings.F2: In choppy, the continuation is stronger after falls than after rises. After a negative 30-day return the 7-day unusual move in the month's direction is +5.1 % (t 2.67, 54 days; graded t 2.12). After a positive one it is +1.7 % (t 0.78, 48 days; graded t 1.08). The ranking inside each side is about the same (Spearman 0.189 after falls, 0.180 after rises).
findings.F3: Within choppy, the graded continuation (scaled 30-day return × unusual 7-day move) sits in calm markets: 0.030 with t 2.25 and Spearman 0.28 (159 cases, 61 days). Agitated choppy markets give t 1.10 and Spearman 0.16 (56 cases).
findings.F4: The graded continuation in choppy grows from 2018 to 2021: Spearman -0.27 (25 cases), 0.07 (59), 0.33 (60), 0.47 (71; t 1.99). Among the windows with enough cases, w12, w15 and w18 are the most positive (graded t 1.71, 2.01, 1.61), and w8 and w14 are negative.
findings.F5: The same continuation holds with a 14-day lookback: graded t 2.05, Spearman 0.24, 215 cases. It is weaker over a 3-day horizon: graded t 1.55, Spearman 0.10, 520 cases on 214 days. The move builds over the week rather than the next days.
findings.F6: The book is short only: 594 SHORT trades with a mean net result of -2.40 %. Most of the losses come from three coins: ZEC -371 % summed, DOGE -297 % and LINK -219 %. Book returns by window swing from -7.3 to +10.1 bp a day. Shorting gives back the coin's normal drift: unusual move +1.13 % against drift -1.13 %, so the total move is -0.01 % per case against a 0.22 % trade cost.
findings.F7: Next-day reversal of a day's close location within its range is clearest in choppy agitated markets: graded (0.5 - close location) × next-day unusual move is 27.2 bp, t 2.81, 435 bars. The other profile pairs give 2.8 to 8.5 bp with t at most 1.64. Across all bars, the next-day unusual move falls from +0.54 % in the lowest-close quintile to -0.39 % in the highest (t 1.62 / -1.74).

ideas.idea: In a choppy, calm market, the larger a coin's 30-day return relative to its own daily swing over the past 30 days, the further it moves the same way over the next 7 days, up after a strong month and down after a weak one.
ideas.consequence: In a trendless, quiet coin, a trader leans with the month's move for a week, sized by how large that move is against the coin's usual swing, instead of fading it as range trading would.
ideas.name: choppy calm month continuation

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the larger a coin's 30-day fall relative to its own daily swing over the past 30 days, the more it falls over the next 7 days.
ideas.consequence: After a weak month in a trendless coin, a trader refuses longs for the next week and shorts more the deeper the scaled fall, because that move is large enough to outweigh the coin's normal upward drift.
ideas.name: choppy scaled month fall continues

ideas.idea: In a choppy, agitated market, the higher a coin closes within its daily range, the more it falls over the next day, and the lower it closes, the more it rises.
ideas.consequence: In a trendless but swinging coin, a trader fades the day's close location for one day, shorting high closes, which no held strategy does in this market.
ideas.name: choppy agitated close fade
